# CLI, MCP, and SDK reference

<!-- Generated by packages/mcp/src/reference.ts. Change that file or the definitions it reads, then run:
pnpm --filter @dohc/mcp exec vitest run src/reference.test.ts -u -->

Agents and developers use this page to work with dohc from outside the app. It lists every MCP tool, `dohc` command, app channel request, and `@dohc/sdk` method, with its arguments and what it returns.

## Connect

- **MCP.** In dohc, open **Settings**, then **Agents & MCP**. Choose **Enable MCP**, then copy the **MCP config** into your agent's MCP settings. The server works on one workspace.
- **CLI.** The `dohc` command talks to the running dohc app, so keep dohc open. Run it inside the workspace folder. Agents that dohc starts have it on their `PATH`.
- **Share links.** A share link has its own MCP endpoint with fewer tools. The [share-web README](../../services/share-web/README.md) says how an agent connects to it.

## Versions and changes

Agent prompts and scripts depend on these names. Before launch, a rename replaces the old name outright, with no alias.

- The MCP server reports its version as `0.3.0`. A rename or removal of a tool, argument, or result field raises it.
- `--json` output carries `schemaVersion: 2`. A change to the shape of that output raises it.
- The CLI and the app must be the same build. Otherwise the CLI stops with `CLI/app version mismatch — restart the app`.

A tool or command that cannot do what was asked returns `{ ok: false, reason }`, or exits with status 1 and prints the reason. MCP marks such a result as an error.

## MCP tools

### `dohc_dataset`

Create, prepare, approve, inspect, and use transactional Collections in the owning workspace. Apps bind to these same datasets; they have no separate private app store. Invoke approved operations with their described revision and a stable retry key. History shows record edits and schema/rule revisions. historyRevision reads immutable saved source. prepareHistoryRestore prepares a reviewed forward change against current records, preserving current access; approveMigration applies it. Source-file restoration alone never activates rules. Permissions manages explicit data grants. Export streams a private recovery archive to an explicit absolute savePath ending in .dohc-recovery; it includes private records, files, history, and retry credentials. Recovery uses prepareRecovery with explicit sourcePath, then claimRecovery after stopping the old host, or discardRecovery to cancel. The same rules apply in dohc and apps.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `request`: one of the [dataset actions](#dataset-actions), with its `action`. Required.

Returns the result of the requested action, listed under [Dataset actions](#dataset-actions).

### `dohc_list_workspaces`

List the local dohc workspaces in the desktop registry.

No arguments.

Returns `{ workspaces: { workspaceId, rootPath, kind, remote? }[] }`.

### `dohc_workspace_status`

Report whether this workspace is local-only or cloud-synced.

No arguments.

Returns `{ synced, scope, cloudConnected, credentialStatus, workspaceId?, serverUrl? }`. `scope` is `"local"` or `"cloud"`.

### `dohc_list_changes`

List workspace history: workspace-engine moments (the recorder for this workspace). Each entry carries path/operation/versionId.

- `sinceMs`: `integer`
- `limit`: `integer`
- `includeFiles`: `boolean`

Returns `{ changes: { id, recordedAtMs, source: "workspace-engine", operation, path, versionId, summary?, author?, fileCount: 1, files? }[], count, totalAvailable, hasMore, cursorMs }`.

### `dohc_read_change`

Read one history entry by id: a workspace-engine moment with its full before/after payload.

- `id`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ ok: true, change: { id, recordedAtMs, source: "workspace-engine", operation, path, versionId, summary?, author?, fileCount: 1, files, before, after } } | { ok: false, reason }`.

### `dohc_list_files`

List visible files and folders in the workspace. Hidden dohc internals are omitted.

- `path`: `string`
- `recursive`: `boolean`

Returns `{ ok: true, root, entries: { path, kind, bytes?, mediaType? }[] }`.

### `dohc_read_file`

Read any visible workspace file as UTF-8 text or base64, returning size and sha256 for safe follow-up writes.

- `path`: `string`. Required.
- `encoding`: `"utf8" | "base64"`
- `maxBytes`: `integer`
- `offsetBytes`: `integer`

Returns `{ ok: true, path, mediaType, encoding, bytes, offsetBytes, sha256, truncated, content }`.

### `dohc_search_files`

Search visible workspace file paths and text contents. Hidden dohc internals, .git, node_modules, symlinks, oversized files, and binary files are skipped.

- `query`: `string`. Required.
- `path`: `string`
- `mode`: `"content" | "path" | "both"`
- `caseSensitive`: `boolean`
- `regex`: `boolean`
- `maxResults`: `integer`
- `maxFileBytes`: `integer`

Returns `{ ok: true, query, root, mode, matches: { type, path, mediaType?, line?, column?, preview }[], matchCount, limitHit, skipped: { path, reason }[] }`.

### `dohc_write_file`

Write an ordinary workspace file. Markdown and Excalidraw documents must be edited in dohc and are refused here. The desktop watcher captures file history while open, or on the next open.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `path`: `string`. Required.
- `content`: `string`. Required.
- `encoding`: `"utf8" | "base64"`
- `expectedSha256`: `string`
- `summary`: `string`

Returns `{ ok: true, path, bytes, sha256, recordedBy }`.

### `dohc_create_directory`

Create a visible workspace directory. Files later written inside it are captured as engine moments by the desktop watcher.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `path`: `string`. Required.
- `summary`: `string`

Returns `{ ok: true, path, recordedBy }`, or `{ ok: true, path, unchanged: true }` when the folder exists.

### `dohc_move_path`

Move or rename a visible workspace file/folder. The desktop watcher captures the change as engine moments while the app is open.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `fromPath`: `string`. Required.
- `toPath`: `string`. Required.
- `overwrite`: `boolean`
- `summary`: `string`

Returns `{ ok: true, fromPath, toPath, recordedBy }`.

### `dohc_delete_path`

Delete a visible workspace file/folder by moving it to dohc's recoverable trash. The desktop watcher captures the delete as an engine moment while the app is open.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `path`: `string`. Required.
- `summary`: `string`

Returns `{ ok: true, path, trashed: true, recordedBy }`.

### `dohc_detect_apps`

Detect app folders in the workspace: web content a browser can open, found from index.html, package.json, dohc.json, and common web configs.

- `path`: `string`
- `maxDepth`: `integer`

Returns `{ ok: true, apps: { root, title, kind, confidence, entry?, packageManager?, scripts, configuredPreviewMode?, buildOutputs, configPath?, diagnostics }[], count, detector }`.

### `dohc_create_app`

Scaffold an app folder with index.html, package.json, a pinned serve devDependency, and an optional dohc.json. Records history; does not create hidden app folders.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.
- `title`: `string`
- `withDohcJson`: `boolean`

Returns `{ ok: true, appRoot, files, recordedBy }`.

### `dohc_test_app`

Run bounded static validation for an app folder: detector diagnostics and entry presence.

- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ ok, app, checks: { name, ok, message?, path? }[] }`. `ok` is true when every check passes.

### `dohc_import_data`

Import a CSV/JSON/JSONL/Markdown source into a new visible .sqlite database.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `sourcePath`: `string`. Required.
- `databasePath`: `string`. Required.
- `tableName`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ ok: true, path, tableName, rowCount, recordedBy }`.

### `dohc_query_database`

Run a single read-only SELECT against a visible workspace database (bounded rows).

- `databasePath`: `string`. Required.
- `sql`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ ok: true, rows }`, with at most 1,000 rows.

### `dohc_list_file_chats`

List the dohc Chats linked to a workspace file. Chats follow the file's stable dohc identity across renames. Requires the workspace engine.

- `path`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ ok: true, path, fileObjectId, threads: { id, title, createdAtMs, updatedAtMs, linkedPathHint? }[] } | { ok: false, reason }`.

### `dohc_read_chat`

Read one dohc Chat thread: its messages (with author kind and display name) and a read-only text projection.

- `threadId`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ ok: true, thread: { id, title, createdAtMs, updatedAtMs, linkedPathHint? }, messages: { id, threadId, authorKind, authorDisplayName, authorOwnerDisplayName?, body, createdAtMs, parentMessageId?, attachments, needsDecision, decisionState?, options?, chosenOption?, resolvedByMessageId? }[], projection: { path, readOnly: true, text } } | { ok: false, reason }`.

### `dohc_list_groups`

List the workspace's Chats groups (including the default #general) with each group's chats and their ids. It also returns direct messages and the agent lane, told apart by `kind`. Requires the workspace engine.

No arguments.

Returns `{ ok: true, groups: { kind, id, name, slug, purpose?, threadCount, threads }[] } | { ok: false, reason }`.

### `dohc_start_group_chat`

Start a new chat in a group as the agent. `group` accepts a group name, #slug, or id. No title needed; the chat displays its first message. `attachments` are workspace-relative paths of tracked files; `needsDecision` asks for a decision and `options` turns it into a poll; `runId` links the message to a local agent run. Returns engine ids usable with dohc_read_chat.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `group`: `string`. Required.
- `title`: `string`
- `body`: `string`. Required.
- `attachments`: `string[]`
- `needsDecision`: `boolean`
- `options`: `string[]`
- `runId`: `string`

Returns `{ ok: true, group: { id, slug, kind }, threadId, messageId, title, warning? }`.

### `dohc_reply_to_chat`

Reply in a dohc Chat thread as the agent. `to` replies under one message; `resolve` closes that open decision with this reply and `choose` names the option picked. Message ids come from dohc_read_chat. `attachments`, `needsDecision`, `options`, and `runId` behave as in dohc_start_group_chat.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `threadId`: `string`. Required.
- `to`: `string`
- `resolve`: `string`
- `choose`: `string`
- `body`: `string`. Required.
- `attachments`: `string[]`
- `needsDecision`: `boolean`
- `options`: `string[]`
- `runId`: `string`

Returns `{ ok: true, threadId, messageId, parentMessageId?, resolvedMessageId?, warning? }`.

### `dohc_query_collection`

Query a collection folder's indexed records: filter, sort, group, and page. Requires the workspace engine and the dohc app.

- `collectionPath`: `string`. Required.
- `filter`: `{ field: string, operator: "equals" | "contains", value: any JSON }`
- `sort`: `({ field: string, direction: "asc" | "desc" })[]`
- `groupBy`: `string`
- `resolveRelations`: `boolean`
- `limit`: `integer`
- `cursor`: `any JSON`

Returns `{ ok: true, collection: { path, status, reasons }, records: { id, path, conflicted, values }[], groups: { value, records }[] | null, nextCursor: { sortValues, recordPath, recordId } | null } | { ok: false, reason }`.

### `dohc_read_record`

Read one collection record by id: current field values plus per-field history with author attribution. Requires the workspace engine and the dohc app.

- `collectionPath`: `string`. Required.
- `recordId`: `string`. Required.
- `historyLimit`: `integer`
- `beforeHistoryId`: `integer`

Returns `{ ok: true, collection: { path, status, reasons }, record: { id, path, conflicted, values }, history: { historyId, field, previous, next, authorOriginId, actorKind, onBehalfOf, depth, recordedAtMs }[] } | { ok: false, reason }`.

### `dohc_set_record_fields`

Set fields on a collection record as the agent, e.g. fields: {"status": "done"}. The change lands in the record's live frontmatter, open desktop views update, and record history attributes it to the agent.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `recordPath`: `string`. Required.
- `fields`: `{ [key: string]: any JSON }`. Required.

Returns `{ ok: true, recordPath } | { ok: false, reason }`.

### `dohc_create_record`

Create a Markdown record in a collection folder as the agent, optionally seeding fields, and return its record id. A name already taken in the folder is refused.

Changes the workspace, so a shared view does not offer it.

- `collectionPath`: `string`. Required.
- `name`: `string`. Required.
- `fields`: `{ [key: string]: any JSON }`

Returns `{ ok: true, recordId, recordPath } | { ok: false, reason }`.

## CLI

```sh
dohc [--as-agent] [--json] <chat | dataset | app> <verb> [arguments]
```

- `--as-agent` acts as the agent instead of the person. Setting `DOHC_CHAT_ACTOR=agent` does the same for `dohc chat`.
- `--json` prints the result as JSON instead of text.
- `DOHC_RUN_ID` links the messages that `post` and `reply` write to a local agent run.
- `DOHC_STATE_DIR` names the app's state folder when the CLI cannot find the running app in its default place.

### `dohc chat`

Reads and writes the workspace's chats.

#### `dohc chat groups`

```sh
dohc chat groups
```

Lists the workspace's groups.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, groups: { kind, id, name, slug, purpose? }[] }`.

#### `dohc chat threads`

```sh
dohc chat threads <group>
```

Lists a group's threads. `<group>` is a name, `#slug`, or id.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, group: { kind, id, name, slug, purpose? }, threads: { lane?, id, title, commentCount, openDecisionCount, unread, updatedAtMs }[] }`.

#### `dohc chat inbox`

```sh
dohc chat inbox
```

Lists threads with unread messages, and messages that mention you.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, threads: { lane?, id, title, commentCount, openDecisionCount, unread, updatedAtMs, group }[], mentions: { threadId, messageId, group, author, createdAtMs, text }[] }`.

#### `dohc chat show`

```sh
dohc chat show <thread-or-message> [--peek]
```

Prints a thread, or the thread around one message, and marks it read.

- `--peek`: Leaves the thread unread. A read-only workspace requires it.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, thread: { id, title, group, commentCount, openDecisionCount }, messages: { id, author, body, createdAtMs, parentMessageId?, decisionState?, decisionOptions?, decisionChosenOption?, attachments, runId? }[] }`.

#### `dohc chat post`

```sh
dohc chat post <group> [--title <title>] [--attach <path>]... [--needs-decision] [--option <choice>]... <body>
```

Starts a thread in a group. A `<body>` of `-` reads the body from stdin.

- `--title`: Titles the thread. Without it, the thread shows its first message.
- `--attach`: Attaches a tracked workspace file. Repeat it for more files.
- `--needs-decision`: Asks the readers for a decision.
- `--option`: Adds a poll choice and implies `--needs-decision`. Repeat it for each choice.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, group: { kind, id, name, slug, purpose? }, threadId, messageId, title, warning? }`.

#### `dohc chat reply`

```sh
dohc chat reply <thread> [--to <message>] [--attach <path>]... [--needs-decision] [--option <choice>]... [--resolve <message> [--choose <choice>]] <body>
```

Replies in a thread. A `<body>` of `-` reads the body from stdin.

- `--to`: Replies under one message.
- `--attach`: Attaches a tracked workspace file. Repeat it for more files.
- `--needs-decision`: Asks the readers for a decision.
- `--option`: Adds a poll choice and implies `--needs-decision`. Repeat it for each choice.
- `--resolve`: Closes that message's open decision with this reply.
- `--choose`: Names the poll choice picked. It needs `--resolve`.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, threadId, messageId, parentMessageId?, resolvedMessageId?, warning? }`.

#### `dohc chat react`

```sh
dohc chat react <message> <emoji>
```

Adds your reaction to a message, or removes it if it is there.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, threadId, messageId, emoji, state }`.

#### `dohc chat grep`

```sh
dohc chat grep <pattern> [--group <group>] [--thread <thread>] [--from <author>] [--since <when>] [-i] [-l] [-C <lines>] [--limit <count>] [--regex]
```

Searches thread titles and message text.

- `--group`: Searches one group.
- `--thread`: Searches one thread.
- `--from`: Keeps messages whose author kind is `<author>`, or whose author name contains it.
- `--since`: Keeps messages newer than a date, or than `<days>d` ago.
- `-i`: Ignores case. Without `--regex`, a pattern with no capital letters ignores case anyway.
- `-l`: Prints only the matching thread ids.
- `-C`: Prints that many messages around each match.
- `--limit`: Stops after that many matches. The default is 100.
- `--regex`: Reads `<pattern>` as a regular expression.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, matches: { group, threadId, messageId, author, createdAtMs, text, contextBefore, contextAfter }[] }` or `{ schemaVersion, threadIds }`.

#### `dohc chat export`

```sh
dohc chat export [--all | --group <group> | --thread <thread>] --out <dir>
```

Writes threads as Markdown files into `<dir>`. Without a scope, it writes every thread.

- `--all`: Writes every thread.
- `--group`: Writes one group's threads.
- `--thread`: Writes one thread.
- `--out`: The folder to write into. Required.

With `--json`, prints `{ schemaVersion, files: { threadId, path }[] }`.

### `dohc dataset`

```sh
dohc dataset <action> '<JSON>'
```

Takes one of the [dataset actions](#dataset-actions). The JSON holds the action's arguments. It can leave out `action`, because the command names it. `dohc dataset --help` prints a summary.

### `dohc app`

```sh
dohc app <action> '<JSON>'
```

The JSON holds the action's arguments.

#### `dohc app prepareLocal`

Prepares the app at `appRoot` to run on this computer. Review the result, then `approve` it.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "prepared", approvalId, candidateDigest, appRoot, versionId, sourceRevision, sourcePaths, capabilities, externalNetwork: true, local?: true }`.

#### `dohc app listLocal`

Lists this computer's approved local publications of the app at `appRoot`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "localListed", publications: { publicationId, authorityRevision, appRoot, sourceRevision, active, datasetCapability }[] }`.

#### `dohc app launchLocal`

Opens an approved local app and returns its `127.0.0.1` URL. Keep dohc open while you use it.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicationId`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "localLaunched", publicationId, url }`.

#### `dohc app prepare`

Prepares the app at `appRoot` for people who open a share link. Review the result, then `approve` it.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.
- `shareId`: `string`. Required.
- `grantId`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "prepared", approvalId, candidateDigest, appRoot, versionId, sourceRevision, sourcePaths, capabilities, externalNetwork: true, local?: true }`.

#### `dohc app list`

Lists the shared publications of the app at `appRoot`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.
- `cursor`: `SHA-256 hex`

Returns `{ kind: "listed", publications: ({ publicationId, authorityRevision, shareId, grantId, active, linkCurrent, collectionCapability, datasetCapability, manifestUnavailable: false, appRoot, sourceRevision } | { publicationId, authorityRevision, shareId, grantId, active, linkCurrent, collectionCapability, datasetCapability, manifestUnavailable: true })[], nextCursor }`.

#### `dohc app approve`

Publishes a prepared app. `approvalId` and `candidateDigest` come from `prepare` or `prepareLocal`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `approvalId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `candidateDigest`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "published", publicationId, authorityRevision, local?: true }`.

#### `dohc app cancel`

Cancels a preparation.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `approvalId`: `UUID`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "cancelled" }`.

#### `dohc app withdraw`

Ends a publication. Its Collection keeps its records.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicationId`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `expectedAuthorityRevision`: `integer`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "withdrawn", publicationId, authorityRevision }`.

#### `dohc app revokeCollection`

Removes a publication's access to its Collection.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicationId`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `expectedAuthorityRevision`: `integer`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "collectionRevoked", publicationId, authorityRevision }`.

#### `dohc app reviewReactivation`

Prepares an ended publication to publish again. Review the result, then `approve` it.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicationId`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "prepared", approvalId, candidateDigest, appRoot, versionId, sourceRevision, sourcePaths, capabilities, externalNetwork: true, local?: true }`.

#### `dohc app responses`

Lists the responses that link holders submitted through an app on one link grant.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `grantId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicPrincipalId`: `string`
- `afterAcceptanceId`: `string`
- `limit`: `integer`

Returns `{ action: "list", acceptances: { kind: "accepted", acceptanceId, objectId, momentId, publicPrincipalId, versionId, collectionPath, path, acceptedAtMs }[], nextAcceptanceId }`.

#### `dohc app undo-responses`

Deletes one page of those responses, optionally only one link holder's. `operationId` is an id you choose for this undo.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `grantId`: `string`. Required.
- `publicPrincipalId`: `string`
- `afterAcceptanceId`: `string`
- `limit`: `integer`
- `operationId`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ action: "undo", items: { acceptanceId, status, momentId? }[], nextCursor }`.

## Dataset actions

`dohc dataset <action>` and the `dohc_dataset` tool take the same actions and return the same results. Every action names the `workspaceId` that owns the Collection. Run `describe` to find table, field, and operation ids.

### `list`

Lists the workspace's transactional Collections.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `after`: `UUID`
- `limit`: `integer`
- `includeArchived`: `boolean`

Returns `{ kind: "list", datasets, nextCursor }`.

### `describe`

Describes one Collection: its tables, fields, and approved operations with their ids.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `includeArchived`: `boolean`

Returns `{ kind: "description", dataset, copy?: { offline, savedAtMs, coverage?: "saved-pages" } }`.

### `history`

Lists saved record operations and rule revisions, newest first, with prior values for reversible edits.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `beforeRevision`: `integer`
- `limit`: `integer`

Returns `{ kind: "history", datasetId, headRevision, entries: { revision, operation, callerReference, recordedAtMs, approvedRevisionHash, changesetBytes, attachmentCount, undo?, schema? }[], nextBeforeRevision }`.

### `historyRevision`

Reads the schema and operation source saved with one past revision.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "history-revision", revision, schemaSql, operationSource }`.

### `lifecycle`

Shows whether the Collection is archived and which apps bind to it.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `after`: `string`
- `limit`: `integer`

Returns `{ kind: "lifecycle", archived, generation, reason, apps: { appId, binding }[], nextCursor }`.

### `archive`

Stops the Collection's operations and keeps its records.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "lifecycle-updated", archived, generation, reason? }`.

### `restore`

Resumes an archived Collection under its existing rules.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "lifecycle-updated", archived, generation, reason? }`.

### `deletePreview`

Starts a permanent deletion: lists affected apps and returns the cursor and review token that `delete` needs.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `after`: `string`
- `limit`: `integer`

Returns `{ kind: "delete-preview", archived, generation, reason, apps: { appId, binding }[], nextCursor, cursor: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest }, reviewToken, name, irreversible: true }`.

### `delete`

Permanently removes the Collection's private data and history. It needs `acknowledge: true`. Export first if you need a recovery copy.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `expected`: `{ workspaceId: string, datasetId: UUID, hostEpoch: string, approvedRevisionHash: SHA-256 hex, revision: integer, digest: SHA-256 hex }`. Required.
- `reviewToken`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `acknowledge`: `true`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "deleted", deleted: true, datasetId }`.

### `pendingAttempts`

Lists saved form responses whose retry is pending. Each is committed or unconfirmed.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `after`: `integer`
- `limit`: `integer`

Returns `{ kind: "pending-attempts", datasetId, entries: { reference, operation, recordedAtMs, revision, outcome, attachmentCount }[], nextAfter }`.

### `reconcileAttempt`

Clears the saved retry of a committed response. It needs `acknowledge: true`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `reference`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `acknowledge`: `true`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "attempt-reconciled", cleared: true }`.

### `cancelAttempt`

Cancels an unconfirmed response. It needs `acknowledge: true`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `reference`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `acknowledge`: `true`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "attempt-cancelled", cancelled: true }`.

### `permissions`

Lists the Collection's app bindings and explicit data grants.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `after`: `string`
- `limit`: `integer`

Returns `{ kind: "permissions", permissions: ({ kind: "data", principal, current, metadata } | { kind: "app", principal, current, metadata })[], nextCursor }`.

### `setGrant`

Sets the data grant for one share grant: the approved revision and the operations it may call.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `grantId`: `string`. Required.
- `grant`: `{ revision: integer, revisionSha256: SHA-256 hex, operationIds: UUID[], discover: boolean }`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "grant-updated" }`.

### `removeGrant`

Removes an explicit data grant. `principalKey` comes from `permissions`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `principalKey`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "grant-updated" }`.

### `create`

Creates a Collection from a definition. It writes generated source and approves it.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `definition`: `any JSON`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "approved", revision }`.

### `prepare`

Captures the dataset source at `descriptorPath` for review.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `descriptorPath`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "prepared", preparationId, revision, sourceDigest }`.

### `approve`

Approves a reviewed preparation by its `revisionSha256`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `preparationId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "approved", revision }`.

### `discard`

Discards a preparation. The source files stay in place.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `preparationId`: `UUID`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "discarded" }`.

### `invoke`

Calls one approved operation. Retry an uncertain write with the same `input` and `idempotencyKey`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `operationId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revision`: `integer`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `input`: `any JSON`. Required.
- `idempotencyKey`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "invoked", result, revision, replayed, copy?: { offline, savedAtMs, coverage?: "saved-pages" } }` or `{ kind: "refused", code, message }`.

### `upload`

Uploads one file for a file field, for a later operation to attach.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revision`: `integer`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `fieldId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `idempotencyKey`: `string`. Required.
- `name`: `string`. Required.
- `contentType`: `string`. Required.
- `bytesBase64`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "uploaded", file, replayed }`.

### `file`

Reads an uploaded file, through a read operation when `read` is given.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revision`: `integer`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `fileId`: `string`. Required.
- `read`: `{ operationId: UUID, fieldId: UUID, input: any JSON }`

Returns `{ kind: "file", file, bytesBase64 }`.

### `createForm`

Writes a form app into `appRoot` for one create operation and the chosen fields.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revision`: `integer`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `tableId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `createOperationId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `appRoot`: `string`. Required.
- `title`: `string`
- `fieldIds`: `UUID[]`. Required.
- `relationChoices`: `({ fieldId: UUID, operationId: UUID, labelFieldId: UUID })[]`

Returns `{ kind: "form-created", appRoot, paths }`.

### `prepareRelationChoices`

Prepares a read operation that returns each target record's key and one label field, for a relation picker. Approve it with `approveMigration`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revision`: `integer`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `tableId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `fieldId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `labelFieldId`: `UUID`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "migration-prepared", preparationId, previousRevision, revision, expected: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest }, candidate: { candidateId, expected, approvedRevisionHash, checkpointSha256, expiresAtMs, preview }, sourceDigest, approvalDigest, schemaSql, operationSource, migrationSql, expiresAtMs }`.

### `prepareSchemaChange`

Prepares a field or name change on a generated Collection. Approve it with `approveMigration`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revision`: `integer`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `change`: `{ kind: "renameCollection", name: string } | { kind: "renameTable", tableId: UUID, name: string } | { kind: "renameField", tableId: UUID, fieldId: UUID, name: string } | { kind: "changeField", tableId: UUID, fieldId: UUID, type: "text" | "number" | "checkbox" | "date" | "select" | "multi-select" | "url" | "attachment" | "relation", required: boolean } | { kind: "addField", tableId: UUID, field: { name: string, type: "text" | "number" | "checkbox" | "date" | "select" | "multi-select" | "url" | "attachment", required: boolean, unique: boolean, default?: any JSON, options?: string[] } }`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "migration-prepared", preparationId, previousRevision, revision, expected: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest }, candidate: { candidateId, expected, approvedRevisionHash, checkpointSha256, expiresAtMs, preview }, sourceDigest, approvalDigest, schemaSql, operationSource, migrationSql, expiresAtMs }`.

### `prepareMigration`

Runs a migration SQL file against a saved copy and prepares the new descriptor. Approve it with `approveMigration`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `descriptorPath`: `string`. Required.
- `migrationPath`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "migration-prepared", preparationId, previousRevision, revision, expected: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest }, candidate: { candidateId, expected, approvedRevisionHash, checkpointSha256, expiresAtMs, preview }, sourceDigest, approvalDigest, schemaSql, operationSource, migrationSql, expiresAtMs }`.

### `prepareHistoryRestore`

Prepares a forward change that reverses one saved change against the current records. Approve it with `approveMigration`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revision`: `integer`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `targetRevisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `changedRevisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "migration-prepared", preparationId, previousRevision, revision, expected: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest }, candidate: { candidateId, expected, approvedRevisionHash, checkpointSha256, expiresAtMs, preview }, sourceDigest, approvalDigest, schemaSql, operationSource, migrationSql, expiresAtMs }`.

### `migrationPreviewPage`

Reads the next page of changed rows in a prepared migration.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `preparationId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `after`: `string`
- `limit`: `integer`

Returns `{ kind: "migration-preview-page", changes: { kind, table, key, before, after }[], nextCursor }`.

### `approveMigration`

Applies the reviewed migration checkpoint. It does not run the SQL again.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `preparationId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `revisionSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `approvalDigest`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "migrated", revision, cursor: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest } }`.

### `discardMigration`

Discards a prepared migration.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `preparationId`: `UUID`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "migration-discarded" }`.

### `export`

Writes a private recovery archive to `savePath`, an absolute path ending in `.dohc-recovery`. The archive holds private records, files, history, and retry credentials.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `savePath`: `string`. Required.
- `overwrite`: `boolean`

Returns `{ kind: "exported", savedPath }`.

### `prepareRecovery`

Checks a recovery archive at `sourcePath`, an absolute path ending in `.dohc-recovery`. Review the result before `claimRecovery`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `sourcePath`: `string`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "recovery-prepared", recovery: { transferId, manifestSha256, sourceCursor, revision } | null }`.

### `claimRecovery`

Installs a prepared recovery. Stop the old host first, then pass `oldHostStopped: true`.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `datasetId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `transferId`: `UUID`. Required.
- `manifestSha256`: `SHA-256 hex`. Required.
- `sourceCursor`: `{ workspaceId: string, datasetId: UUID, hostEpoch: string, approvedRevisionHash: SHA-256 hex, revision: integer, digest: SHA-256 hex }`. Required.
- `oldHostStopped`: `true`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "recovery-claimed", transferId, manifestSha256, sourceCursor: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest }, targetCursor: { workspaceId, datasetId, hostEpoch, approvedRevisionHash, revision, digest } }`.

### `discardRecovery`

Cancels a prepared recovery before it is claimed.

- `workspaceId`: `string`. Required.
- `transferId`: `UUID`. Required.

Returns `{ kind: "recovery-discarded" }`.

## App channel

An app page reads and changes its Collection through the app channel. The channel works in two places: a published app opened from a share link, and a local app opened with `dohc app launchLocal`. An app open in a dohc tab has no channel.

When the page loads, its parent window posts `{ kind: "dohc-app-channel", version: 1 }` with one `MessagePort`. The page keeps that port and posts each request to it as `{ id, op, ...fields }`. `id` is 1 to 64 letters, digits, `_`, or `-`, and no two requests in flight share one. The port answers `{ id, ok: true, value }`, or `{ id, ok: false, status }` with status 400, 404, 409, 413, 429, or 503. At most four requests can wait at once.

The app calls only the operations its owner approved when publishing it. `app.publish.json` names them under `dataset.operationIds`. The page never sends a workspace, user, or revision, because the host supplies them.

### `backend.invoke`

Calls one operation the app's publication exposes, by name. Reads use it too, with a new `idempotencyKey` for each call. Retry an uncertain write with the same `input` and `idempotencyKey`.

Fields: `operation`, `input`, `idempotencyKey`.

Answers `{ result, revision, replayed }`. A refusal from the operation arrives as status 409 with `error: { code, message }`.

### `backend.upload`

Uploads one file, at most 5 MiB, for a later operation to attach.

Fields: `name`, `contentType`, `bytesBase64`, `idempotencyKey`.

Answers `{ file, replayed }`.

### `backend.file`

Reads an uploaded file through an exposed read operation.

Fields: `fileId`, `operation`, `input`.

Answers `{ file, bytesBase64 }`.

### `backend.attempt`

Saves, reads, or clears one unconfirmed submission for an operation, so the page can retry it after a reload. `request` is `{ action: "get" }`, `{ action: "save", idempotencyKey, input }`, or `{ action: "clear", token }`.

Fields: `operation`, `request`.

Answers `{ attempt: { token, idempotencyKey, input } | null }`.

### `collection.list`

Lists records of the document Collection a published app binds to, at most 100 at a time. Add `afterPath` to read the next page. Only a published app opened from a share link can send it.

Fields: `limit`.

Answers `{ records: { path, recordId, fields }[], nextPath }`.

### `collection.create`

Adds a record to that Collection. Only a published app opened from a share link can send it.

Fields: `fields`, `idempotencyKey`.

Answers `{ kind: "accepted", acceptanceId, acceptedAtMs, momentId, objectId, path }`.

## SDK

`@dohc/sdk` is the client that plugin panels use. The [SDK README](../../packages/sdk/README.md) shows how to load it. Each `options` argument takes `signal` and `timeoutMs`. A method that needs a capability throws `DOHC_CAPABILITY_DISABLED` when the host turns it off.

- `capabilities()` returns `DohcCapabilityMap`. Reads what this context can do, such as `files.write`. It is a map of what is available, not a permission request.
- `request(method, params?, options?)` returns the host's result. Calls a host method this SDK has no typed wrapper for.
- `invoke(method, params?, options?)` returns the host's result. Another name for `request`.
- `subscribe(method, params, listener, options?)` returns a function that stops the subscription. Subscribes to host events this SDK has no typed wrapper for.
- `files.read(path, options?)` returns the text. Reads a text file. It throws `DOHC_RESPONSE_TRUNCATED` when the host sent only part of the file. Needs the `files.read` capability.
- `files.readInfo(path, options?)` returns `{ text, truncated }`. Reads a text file and says whether the host cut it short. Needs the `files.read` capability.
- `files.list(path?, listOptions?, options?)` returns `{ path, name?, kind?, size?, modifiedAt? }[]`. Lists files. `listOptions` takes `recursive` and `includeHidden`. Needs the `files.list` capability.
- `files.write(path, text, writeOptions?, options?)` returns `{ path }`. Writes a text file. `writeOptions.overwrite: false` refuses an existing file. Live Markdown documents are refused. Needs the `files.write` capability.
- `files.watch(path, listener, options?)` returns a function that stops the watch. Reports settled changes at or below `path`, each `{ path, operation, sha256? }`. `operation` is `update` or `delete`. Needs the `files.watch` capability.
- `workspace.search(query, searchOptions?, options?)` returns `{ path?, title?, excerpt?, score? }[]`. Searches the workspace. `searchOptions` takes `path`, `limit`, and `types`. Needs the `workspace.search` capability.
- `databases.read({ path, query?, params? }, options?)` returns the host's result. Reads a workspace database, with an optional read-only query. Needs the `databases.read` capability.
- `databases.edit({ path, query?, params?, operations? }, options?)` returns the host's result. Changes a workspace database with one query or exactly one operation. Needs the `databases.edit` capability.
- `ui.open(target, openOptions?, options?)` returns `{ target, position? }`. Opens a workspace path in dohc. `openOptions.position` is `active`, `beside`, or `new-tab`. Needs the `ui.open` capability.
- `ui.openWebApp(webAppId, instanceKey, options?)` returns the host's result. Opens one instance of the plugin's own web app in a tab. Only a panel can call it. Needs the `ui.open` capability.
- `ui.theme(options?)` returns `DohcTheme`. Reads dohc's design tokens as they are on screen.
- `ui.applyTheme(applyOptions?)` returns a function that stops following the theme. Writes dohc's design tokens onto the page and keeps them current.
- `collections.list(options?)` returns an array of Collection objects. Lists the Collections this context can read. Needs the `collections.read` capability.
- `collections.get(path, options?)` returns the Collection object. Reads one Collection. Needs the `collections.read` capability.
- `collections.query(path, queryOptions?, options?)` returns an object with `records`. Queries records. `queryOptions` takes `filter`, `sort`, `groupBy`, `resolveRelations`, `limit`, and `cursor`, as `dohc_query_collection` does. Needs the `collections.read` capability.
- `collections.getRecord(path, recordId, recordOptions?, options?)` returns the record with its history. Reads one record. `recordOptions` takes `historyLimit` and `beforeHistoryId`. Needs the `collections.read` capability.
- `collections.setFields(recordPath, fields, options?)` returns `{ path }`. Sets fields on a record. Needs the `collections.edit` capability.
- `collections.createRecord(path, { name, fields? }, options?)` returns the new record's id and path. Creates a record in a Collection. Needs the `collections.edit` capability.
- `collections.watch(collectionPath, listener, options?)` returns a function that stops the watch. Reports record changes at or below `collectionPath`, at most once each. Read record history to catch up on missed events. Needs the `collections.read` capability.
- `provenance.record(summary, options?)` returns nothing. Records a summary of what the caller did. `summary` is a string or `{ summary, ... }`. Needs the `provenance.record` capability.
